name: Mirascope
description: Calls any frontier LLM through one Python or TypeScript interface with decorators for structured output, tools, agents, and streaming, for developers building LLM applications.

skills.name: Unified LLM Calls
skills.description: Calls models from any supported provider through one decorator-based interface.

skills.name: Structured Output
skills.description: Parses model responses into Pydantic models via a format argument.

skills.name: Tools and Agents
skills.description: Defines tools as decorated functions and runs agent loops that execute tool calls and resume.

skills.name: Streaming
skills.description: Streams model responses as they are generated.
